finalText:
Redis went down at 02:14:07 and never came back. That triggered the cascade.

When Redis dropped, the cache layer degraded and everything fell back to direct database reads. The database got hammered with all those uncached requests — the `orders` keys especially — and started timing out. Those timeouts piled up in the request queue, which grew from normal levels to 562–568 items (limit is 500). The app kept retrying failed requests, the backlog just got deeper, and it consumed all available memory by 02:31:44. Worker-2 ran out of heap, crashed with code 134, then the API became unresponsive and got killed.

The whole thing took 17 minutes from Redis failing to the out-of-memory crash.

**What actually happened:** Redis at `10.0.0.12:6379` went down. Reconnect tried 12 times and never succeeded. Without caching, the database couldn't handle the request volume.
